info.title: Neomorphic opportunity intake
info.description: Sibling of the earned-work kernel for one configurable funded round. Claims reserve an atomic budget and, after owner acceptance, record an owed IOU on adapter null_nonpaying_v0. This service does not transfer USDC, fetch artifact refs, enroll production credentials from fixtures, or change a closed campaign's preserved promise. The kernel contract remains openapi.json. A waitlist is not a paid slot.

servers.description: Local earned-work process. Not hosted escrow.

post.description: Fixed terms include offer summary and ownerReservedSlots (optional, default 0, at most slotCount). This aggregate protects already sent personal capacity before private identity imports. Fixture imports are synthetic. Production admission and contributor grants require owner authorization.

409.description: Terms already fixed or expected hash mismatch

get.description: Local service inventory only. publicClaimConfigured and unreservedPublicSlots describe configuration; publicClaimable=false, publicRemainingSlots=0 and deliveryState=unconfigured until Root integrates and verifies a real delivery path. remainingAtomic includes protectedPersonalAtomic; availableAtomic excludes that protection. No hosted self-service claim endpoint is asserted.

200.description: Public round view. Reading does not reserve a reward.
Same import key replayed without a new token
Owner claim index without credential secrets

409.description: Closed, full, mismatch, or oversubscribed. Body is a waitlist or next task, not a bare rejection and not an unbudgeted paid promise.

200.description: Holder or owner readback. Assigned scope stays with the holder.

post.description: Evidence is untrusted self-report, bounded and digest-bound. Discovery accepts kind and selfReport only. Workflow requires nonempty attempt, limitationOrResult and syntheticFailure=false, with optional versions/minimalInput/expectedResult. Verification and settlement fields are rejected. The idempotency body binds claimId.

201.description: Evidence metadata stored. Ref is not fetched.

409.description: Deferred start, late reservation, or different duplicate evidence

200.description: Deferred start cleared by the holder. Still not a transfer.

409.description: Unearned reservation expired or no longer open for work. Owed and submitted records are retained.

post.description: Authenticated server event ids and request path are retained separately from all volunteered source, provider, query and observed assertions. Claimant source assertions do not authenticate a provider or verify evidence.

201.description: Self-report stored separately from observed request evidence.

200.description: Contacted, delivered, claimed, completed, accepted. Paid obligation count stays 0.

201.description: Denominator observation. Sent is not delivery. A paid observation is not revenue.

200.description: Round closed. Accepted obligations stay owed.

201.description: Closed campaign notice with an immutable preserved promise

get.description: Public fields are redacted, including retained legacy rows. Continuation path is null while delivery is unconfigured. Immutable preserved promise is retained in storage.

200.description: Preserved promise and a non-paying continuation pointer
